pairs.title: Metronidazole and warfarin
pairs.text: Metronidazole can increase the effect of warfarin and raise the risk of bleeding. Ask your prescriber or pharmacist to review these medicines together.

source.name: NAFDAC Greenbook · Metronidazole product information, section 4.5

pairs.title: Metronidazole and lithium
pairs.text: Metronidazole can slow the removal of lithium from the body. Ask your prescriber or pharmacist to review these medicines together.

source.name: NAFDAC Greenbook · Metronidazole product information, section 4.5

pairs.title: Clarithromycin and simvastatin
pairs.text: The product information warns that using these together can cause serious muscle injury. Ask your prescriber or pharmacist to review the combination promptly.

source.name: NAFDAC Greenbook · Clarithromycin product information, section 4.5

pairs.title: Co-trimoxazole and warfarin
pairs.text: Co-trimoxazole can increase the effect of warfarin. Ask your prescriber or pharmacist to review these medicines together.

pairs.title: Ampicillin and cloxacillin with allopurinol
pairs.text: The Euroclox product leaflet reports an increased risk of skin rash when this combination is used with allopurinol. Ask the prescriber or pharmacist to review the two medicines together.

pairs.title: Clarithromycin and colchicine
pairs.text: The product leaflet flags this combination because clarithromycin can increase exposure to colchicine. Ask the prescriber or pharmacist to review the two medicines together.

source.name: NAFDAC Greenbook · Clarithromycin product information, sections 4.3 and 4.5

pairs.title: Co-amoxiclav and methotrexate
pairs.text: Co-amoxiclav can increase the risk of side effects from methotrexate. Ask a pharmacist or prescriber to check these medicines together.

source.name: NAFDAC Greenbook · Co-amoxiclav product information, section 4.5

pairs.title: Co-amoxiclav and probenecid
pairs.text: Probenecid can raise and prolong amoxicillin levels when used with co-amoxiclav. Ask a pharmacist or prescriber to check these medicines together.

source.name: NAFDAC Greenbook · Co-amoxiclav product information, section 4.5
